name: 圖片拼貼連結卡片＋置中文字組的圖文並排
desc: 左右貼齊畫面、四角圓角的區塊：左側是一張圖片拼貼的內縮連結卡片，右側是置中的文字組，兩欄垂直置中。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊是卡片，左右貼齊畫面邊緣，上下留邊；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。區塊內左右兩欄、兩欄垂直置中：左欄約佔畫面寬三成多，是一張內縮的連結卡片，上方是圖片拼貼（左側一張大圖約佔卡片寬三分之二，右側一欄窄長的直向小圖），下方是大字標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤、下方可放次要文字，沒有時省略，卡片右下角放一顆小圖示按鈕；右欄是置中的文字組：大標題（可多行），是區塊中最大的字，下方可放小字副標、第二層標題（可多行）、說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：置中的文字組在上，連結卡片在下，卡片左右留邊；卡片內的圖片拼貼結構不變。區塊仍左右貼齊畫面邊緣、四個角做圓角。

en.name: Split image-collage link card + centered text group
en.desc: A section flush with both screen edges and rounded at all four corners: an inset link card with an image collage on the left and a centered text group on the right, both columns vertically centered.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is a card, flush with the left and right edges of the screen, with margin above and below; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) are rounded corners. The section has two columns, vertically centered: the left column, a bit over thirty percent of the screen width, is an inset link card with an image collage at the top (one large image on the left taking about two thirds of the card width, and a narrow column of portrait small images on the right), and below it a large title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and secondary text below; omit them when there is no content; a small icon button sits in the card's bottom-right corner. The right column is a centered text group: a large headline (may wrap to multiple lines), the largest text in the section, optionally with a small subheading, a second-level title (may wrap to multiple lines), a description and a button below it; omit them when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The layout becomes a vertical stack: the centered text group on top and the link card below, with margin on the left and right of the card; the image collage inside the card keeps its structure. The section stays flush with the left and right edges of the screen with all four corners rounded.

extras.name: 連結卡片的小圖欄持續直向流動
extras.prompt: 連結卡片圖片拼貼右側那一欄窄長的小圖，持續往同一方向直向流動，小圖首尾相接循環，上下被欄位邊緣裁切。

en.name: Small-image column in the link card flows vertically
en.prompt: The narrow column of small images on the right of the link card's image collage flows continuously in one vertical direction, looping end to end, with images cropped by the top and bottom edges of the column.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: On mobile the vertical flow is kept.
